what: Photos stacked in one place change every 4 seconds while visible on screen. The new photo is revealed as a rounded gradient mask twice the screen size descends from above and wipes it in with a soft curved edge (2.4s cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1)), and the previous photo stays visible underneath. With auto: off, it changes only on the fx:go signal.

options.ease: Wipe curve, either in the form 0.33,1,0.68,1 or as a CSS curve name, default is that one
options.auto: When off it does not advance on its own — only via the fx:go event (detail.index). Used when another motion swaps two sheets
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Photos to overlap (two or more). Fires fx:change(detail.index) on the element at each turn

note: The original is a black oval PNG mask (200% size, center 200% → 0%) — the same curved edge was redrawn with radial-gradient. It pauses when off screen (same as the original IntersectionObserver)

from.where: index.html booking section three photos (.ws-aside__slides) · two vertical photos in the service panel (auto: off)
